## Checklist

- [ ] `go test ./...` passes
- [ ] `gofmt -l .` prints nothing and `go vet ./...` is clean
- [ ] Added or updated tests where it made sense
- [ ] If this adds or changes an assistant tool, there's a test for it and the system prompt still describes it accurately
- [ ] Only made-up names in tests, demo data and examples
- [ ] No database files, secrets, or API keys committed
